proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5808 The tigma addendum tentatively compares Assamese ṭeṅā, phonetically tεṅa, sour/acrid. Hajong teŋa is provisionally linked through this precise comparison; Turner’s question mark and uncertain deeper derivation are retained. Exact survey form teŋa is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
